material_findings.title: GSA opened a government-workforce MCP and AI-agent hackathon with explicit sandbox authorization boundaries
material_findings.summary: GSA is running a virtual Sep-Nov 2026 MCP Server and AI Agent Government Hackathon for government employees with .gov or .mil addresses. Participants prototype dataset-access, service-read, or sandbox-only service-write MCP servers. The official page explicitly limits exploration to sandbox environments and publicly available government data and says prototypes will not be publicly deployed. There are no monetary prizes; winners receive recognition. Registration is open but space is limited, while exact completion/final-presentation/awards dates are still being finalized.
material_findings.recommended_action: Keep this as a specialized lead unless participant eligibility is independently established. If eligibility exists, preserve registration state, agency/system-owner approval for any service-delivery API, exact final dates, and the specific sandbox/data scope before creating a structured case. Otherwise use the published architecture/evaluation criteria only as research inspiration for benign local MCP fixtures.
